purpose_context: A Kitty Variation chrome enhancement: wrap Starlight's PageSidebar so the desktop on-this-page TOC can be hidden behind an edge toggle, the main column re-centers to full width, and the choice persists across reloads and client navigations without a flash — while mobile keeps Starlight's existing TOC and the left docs sidebar is untouched.
purpose_tldr: Let desktop readers collapse the on-this-page outline to reclaim article width, with the preference remembered and mobile unchanged.
